03 A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curious about
what’s underneath.

Q
Queen’s UniversityBachelor of Computing, Software DesignThird year student

I’ve been interested in computers since I was a kid. I’ve always wanted to understand what they can do and how they work. That curiosity led me to study Software Design at Queen’s University.

I enjoy the process of narrowing down a bug, finding the reason behind it, and making the fix hold up. My projects let me explore that from different angles: structured data and APIs in Java, and uncertain visual input in Python.

Away from code, I build and troubleshoot PCs. Working through component compatibility, cooling, and hardware faults gives me another way to understand a system from the inside out.
